update_text: Item merging and cloud save are here! Combine spare gear into higher rarities and back up your progress to Google Play Games. Update now!
title: MERGE & CLOUD SAVE
message: New in 1.2.0: merge 3 spare items into 1 of the next rarity (5 Epics make a Legendary), or hit MERGE ALL in your bag. Your progress now backs up to Google Play Games too, so you can carry on if you change phones. Thanks for playing!
